visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a young woman standing in a brightly lit Watsons retail store. She wears a white Adidas-style jacket over a beige top and a pearl necklace. The background shows shelves of eyewear and beauty products. She smiles at the camera, introducing a shopping haul of five items. (2) In the first phase, she showcases 'loveil' colored contact lenses. She points to a pink display stand featuring Japanese singer Koda Kumi. She holds a black box of lenses close to the lens. The camera pans across the shelf to show various color options available. She makes a peace sign. (3) Next, she focuses on AOU Cloud Matte Balm. She holds a small red circular container while a photo of K-pop idol Giselle appears as an overlay. She shows a close-up of the square packaging decorated with pink flowers. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the product textures. (4) The host moves to a section for trial-sized luxury skincare. She points at small bottles of SK-II Essence behind a clear acrylic shelf. She picks one up, showing the label and the price tag of 229. She puts it into her black mesh shopping bag, which already contains previous items. (5) She holds up a package of Mdmmd sanitary pads with a purple cartoon design featuring Chibi Maruko-chan. She gestures enthusiastically towards the characters on the bag. The background shows rows of other personal care products on typical retail shelving. She appears happy with the cute design. (6) At the checkout or a specialized counter, she shows PegaVision Butterbear contact lenses. The display features cute illustrated bear characters. She uses a tablet to show close-ups of eye patterns and compares different lens effects. The camera pans from the tablet screen back to her face. (7) In the final segment, she concludes her shopping trip. She holds the AOU balm again, posing with a finger heart gesture. The scene ends with her smiling warmly at the camera, surrounded by the retail environment of the store. Text overlays appear at the bottom summarizing her haul.
